parameters.jsonBody: {"query":"SELECT campaign.name, campaign.status, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.conversions, metrics.ctr, metrics.average_cpc FROM campaign WHERE segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS ORDER BY metrics.cost_micros DESC"}

{"query":"SELECT ad_group_criterion.keyword.text, ad_group_criterion.keyword.match_type, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.conversions, metrics.average_cpc FROM keyword_view WHERE segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS AND ad_group_criterion.status != 'REMOVED' ORDER BY metrics.cost_micros DESC LIMIT 30"}

{"query":"SELECT search_term_view.search_term, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.conversions FROM search_term_view WHERE segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS ORDER BY metrics.impressions DESC LIMIT 50"}
